scope: Synthetic token histories hashed with model metadata, not tokenizer text or measured generation routing.
Method phases use disjoint seeded histories; initial page residency is measured but no cache is dropped.
Warm case repeats current row IDs immediately, not a complete conversation replay.
mmap ACCESS_COPY is never written; input files remain unchanged.
Explicit pread is buffered; direct-preadv bypasses OS page cache except for the prototype's own cache.
No simulated compute, no CPU/GPU math, no end-to-end inference speed claim.
Byte equality is against the same local file, not verification of the publisher's full file hashes.
